SPACEPUB

Four bars, one soda jerk, a galaxy of thirsty customers. Pour, slide, catch the empties, and never let a shake hit the floor.

KEYBOARD

↑ ↓ or W S
jump to another counter
1 2 3 4
jump straight to that counter
← → or A D
run along the counter (grab tips)
Space · Enter · X · Ctrl
pour - HOLD mode: hold, let go to slide · TAP mode: one press (T switches)
H · Q
send holy water · show the cross (devils, demons, vampires flee)
P or Esc
pause · F, F11 or Alt+Enter full screen
2 players
P1: W A S D + Space, H holy, Q cross · P2: arrows + Enter, . holy, , cross (or a controller each)
F · M · N · G · L · C · J · B · V
full screen · sound · music · graphics · look · CRT screen · music box · bartender · wide/tall layout
Menus
arrows / D-pad to move, Enter / A to choose, Esc / B back

CONTROLLER

D-pad / stick ↑ ↓ · LB RB
change counter
D-pad / stick ← →
run along the counter
A (✕) · X (□) · LT · RT
pour (it rumbles when you catch, lose or power up)
Y (△) · B (○)
holy water · show the cross
Start
start / pause

TOUCH

Tap a counter · swipe ↑ ↓
change counter
POUR or your own counter
pour (TAP mode is the default on touch screens)
◀ ▶ · drag sideways
run
✝ CROSS · HOLY
show the cross · send holy water (from level 2)

Tip: turn your phone sideways for a bigger view.

    TIME FOR A STRETCH!

    You've been playing for a while. Stand up, stretch your arms up high, wiggle your fingers, look out of the window and have a drink of water!

    MUSIC BOX

    Every planet has its own tune. Pick one and listen. Arrows or D-pad to choose, Enter or A to play, Esc or B to go back.

    PAUSED

    STILL THERE? The game paused itself so you don't lose a life while you're away. Press FIRE or RESUME to carry on.

    Keyboard: ↑ ↓ or 1-4 counters · ← → run · Space pour · T pour mode · P resume. Controller: D-pad or LB/RB · A pour · Start resume. Touch: tap or swipe the counters, POUR button.
